ANÁLISE E PROCESSAMENTO DE IMAGENS BIOMÉ.ementa: Introduction to image processing. Introduction to the computational environment used to implement the techniques. Image preprocessing: 2D convolution, spatial filtering, 2D Fourier transform, frequency-domain filtering. Introduction to numerical operators for image processing: gradient, Laplacian, segmentation, thresholding, binary mathematical morphology. DICOM and PACS. Physical principles of image formation and characteristics of the main modalities (X-ray, Computed Tomography, Ultrasonography, Nuclear Medicine, Nuclear Magnetic Resonance).

ANÁLISE QUANTITATIVA DO SISTEMA CARDIOVA.ementa: The role of circulation in the body; the circulation; the heart and the vascular bed and their relationships with other organs; functional anatomy of the heart and coronary circulation. Bioelectrogenesis in cardiac cells; genesis and conduction of the heart's electrical activity. Excitation-contraction coupling in the cardiac cell. The origin of the electrocardiogram (ECG) and its leads. ECG interpretation. Qualitative and quantitative aspects of the cardiac cycle and cardiac output; oxygen and energy consumption; microcirculation and lymphatic circulation. Circulation from the point of view of fluid mechanics. Modulating agents of the cardiovascular system. Cardiovascular models for assessing the pressure-volume relationship; cardiac work and power. Cardiac electrostimulation: pacing and cardioversion.

APLICAÇÕES DE IA GENERATIVA EM PESQUISA.ementa: Fundamentals and applications of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) in scientific and technological research activities. Responsible use of Generative AI, its limitations, risks and implications for research integrity and quality. Techniques for interacting with AI and formulating queries to support scientific tasks, the survey and analysis of technical information, and the preparation of academic documents. AI-assisted programming: generation, comprehension, debugging, testing and validation of computer code. AI-supported data analysis: exploration, processing, interpretation and verification of results in scientific computing environments. Application of generative models to problem solving involving mathematical, statistical, computational and optimization methods. Critical evaluation of results produced with the aid of AI, including the identification of hallucinations, comparison with reference methods and analysis of limitations. Reproducibility, traceability and documentation of the use of AI in research processes. Strategies for methodological validation and the integration of generative tools into the scientific method. Development of applied scientific or technological research projects using Generative AI.

APRENDIZADO DE MÁQUINA APLICADO A SINAIS.ementa: Fundamentals of pattern recognition applied to biomedical signals and images. Feature selection for signals and images: main techniques in the time and frequency domains; statistical and information-theory-based features. Main machine learning techniques applied to Biomedical Engineering. Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Independent Component Analysis (ICA). Linear Regression. Principal Component Regression (PCR). Partial Least Squares Regression (PLS). Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). Perceptron and introduction to neural networks. Support Vector Machines (SVM). Bayesian classification strategies. Bayesian networks. Classifier fusion. Testing and validation of classifiers in medical applications. Cross-validation.

BIOESTATÍSTICA.ementa: The course aims to stimulate critical thinking in statistical analyses applied to Biomedical Engineering and Medicine. Using fundamental mathematical concepts and rigor, the course focuses on the demonstration and practical use of hypothesis tests and p-value calculation, without the use of statistical software or packages. In this way, students better assimilate the mathematical notation most frequently used in scientific articles and develop a stronger critical sense about the main problems involved in the inappropriate use of statistical tools and concepts. Syllabus: Descriptive statistics: measures of central tendency; measures of dispersion and histogram. Concepts of probability. One-dimensional discrete random variables. Probability distributions. Expectation and variance. Probability distributions (theoretical and empirical): main concepts. Probability distributions: Gaussian. Sampling and estimation. Confidence intervals. Concepts in hypothesis testing. Z and T tests for one variable. Joint and conditional probability. Hypothesis testing for two variables (paired and unpaired tests). Type I and Type II errors in hypothesis testing. Correlation analysis and Pearson coefficient. Applications to problems in Biomedical Engineering and Medicine.

BIOÉTICA E METODOLOGIA CIENTÍFICA.ementa: Principles of bioethics in the technoscientific field; ethics and morality; legal aspects of bioethics in Brazil and worldwide. Good academic practices and combating plagiarism. Ethics committees and methodological assessment; rules of conduct in animal and human experimentation. Protocols in clinical medicine; use of sample banks and biological information. Social responsibility. Ethics and the environment. Principles, historical aspects and application of the scientific method in the investigation and solution of scientific problems; systematic approach to a literature review; study design and experimental design.

Respiratory mechanics - main mathematical models of respiratory mechanics and pulmonary mechanical ventilation. Representation of biological systems as mechanical and electrical elements.

FISIOLOGIA INTEGRATIVA: PERCEPÇÃO, RACIO.ementa: Advanced study of human physiology with emphasis on the integration among organ systems (cardiovascular, renal, neural and musculoskeletal) and on adaptations to physical exercise. The course explores the mechanisms of homeostatic and allostatic regulation through an approach that integrates logical reasoning, critical analysis and perception processes. Innovative, unconventional teaching strategies are employed, including the systematic observation of patterns in nature, the analysis of artistic expressions and symbolic construction, as tools for the conceptual modeling of complex physiological phenomena. The focus is on developing integrated scientific thinking, formulating hypotheses and interpreting dynamic biological systems.

COMUNICAÇÃO CIENTÍFICA.ementa: Introduction to Scientific Communication; plagiarism and good academic practices; overall structure of a scientific article. Specific structures: Title, Abstract, Keywords, Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results, Discussion and Conclusion; characteristics and language of each section. Design of the information flow; verb tense options; sentence structures and types (topic sentences, hooks, emphatic and minimizing sentences); formatting and basic rules for including and using elements (Figures, Tables, Equations, References); oral presentations (structure and information flow); introduction to aspects of communication (visual, auditory and kinesthetic); poster (distribution of information and trade-off between text and images).

CONTROLE DIGITAL.ementa: Introduction to digitally controlled systems. Relationship between continuous time and discrete time with sampling and signal reconstruction. Z-transform. Stability analysis in the discrete domain. Conversion of continuous controllers to discrete. Discrete-time system identification. Controller design using the root locus method, frequency response and state-space representation.

DESENVOLVIMENTO WEB APLICADO À TELEMEDIC.ementa: The Web Development Applied to Telemedicine course aims to introduce the fundamentals of web-based (client/server) programming, focusing on the design of Telediagnosis and Teleconsultation systems and platforms for managing medical information. Course topics: basic elements of markup language (HTML), style sheets (CSS) and front-end frameworks (emphasis on Bootstrap), structured interpreted programming language (JavaScript and the jQuery library), hosting providers and website management, server-side programming (emphasis on the PHP language), database integration (emphasis on SQL), data authentication mechanisms, introduction to PACS and RIS systems, coding and communication of digital medical images (DICOM), integration of videoconferencing systems, ethical and legal aspects of telemedicine.

Approach to the main topics in Human Physiology with emphasis on the musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, respiratory, renal, endocrine and nervous (central and peripheral) systems.

INTRODUÇÃO AO PROCESSAMENTO DE SINAIS BI.ementa: Characterization of biological signals. Acquisition and recording of biological signals (digitization, sampling and aliasing, signal-to-noise ratio). Biological signals as stochastic processes (stationarity, ergodicity). Decomposition of signals in the frequency domain (spectrum, phase, Fourier transform and introduction to the Wavelet transform). Notions of filters and autoregressive modeling. Covariance, spectral coherence and phase coherence between signals. Applications to biomedical signals: EEG rhythms, evoked potentials, ECG analysis and heart rate variability, EMG analysis.

MODELAGEM FISIOLÓGICA PARA A TERAPIA INT.ementa: 1) Introduction to cardiovascular pathophysiology and autonomic control; definition of acute illness, sepsis, circulatory shock. 2) Examples of open problems in intensive care and solutions based on bioengineering approaches: hemodynamic monitoring, response to pharmacological therapies, prediction of critical events, identification of therapeutic targets and biomarkers; 3) Cardiovascular system modeling: electrical analogy, Ohm's laws applied to fluid dynamics; distributed-parameter and lumped-parameter models; Windkessel-type models of the arterial circulation; pressure-volume relationship and cardiac contractility; cardiopulmonary circulation; fluid dynamic properties of blood; 4) Multiscale modeling and applications to the pathophysiology of intensive care; 5) Analysis of measurements and data in intensive care.

PRINCÍPIOS E MÉTODOS DA NEUROCIÊNCIA COG.ementa: This course aims to introduce the main concepts and quantitative methods of cognitive neuroscience through critical discussions of the various approaches and their applications to basic and clinical problems. 1) Introduction to cognitive neuroscience: perception, cognition and consciousness. 2) Plasticity, learning and memory; 3) Emotion, depression and schizophrenia. 4) Sleep, anesthesia and coma; 5) Measuring brain activity: invasive and non-invasive techniques; spontaneous, evoked and event-related recordings. 6) Spectral analysis and brain rhythms. 7) Information processing in the brain: signaling, information theory, measures of functional and effective connectivity. 8) Neural networks and brain complexity

PROGRAMAÇÃO EM PYTHON APLICADA À ENGENHA.ementa: Introduction to Python. Introduction to the Anaconda package and Google Colab. Introduction to the GitHub platform. Simple variables (int, float and string), low-level data input, reading .json files. Conditional structures, repetition loops (while and for). Compound variables (tuples, lists and dictionaries). Functions. Introduction to programming with classes and objects. Introduction to the use of SQL databases, integration of SQL databases with Python (sqlite); Introduction to the numpy, matplotlib, seaborn and pandas libraries. Applications of Python to Biomedical Engineering problems.

SEMINÁRIOS EM ENGENHARIA BIOMÉDICA.ementa: This course aims to engage students of the Graduate Program in Biomedical Engineering with the various research topics developed in the program and with the most relevant scientific output for the program's research areas. Throughout the semester, seminars and article discussions will be used to address recent advances in prominent topics in Biomedical Engineering, ranging from the understanding of biological systems to the development and application of new technological solutions in healthcare. The seminars may be given by the responsible faculty member, by invited guests and by the students themselves. Readings and discussions will focus primarily on the seminar topics and will be guided by the faculty member to highlight not only the innovative aspects but also the critical analysis of the works, addressing the relationship among methods, results and conclusions.
SEMINÁRIOS EM ENGENHARIA BIOMÉDICA.bibliografia: Artigos em revistas científicas indexadas de maior relevância para as áreas de pesquisa do programa

SISTEMAS CRÍTICOS.ementa: History. Concepts of critical systems. Development processes and life cycle of critical systems. Standards and regulations for critical systems. Techniques and processes for risk, hazard and accident analysis. Requirements and safety specification.

SISTEMAS DE CONTROLE APLICADOS EM ENGENH.ementa: Introduction and basic concepts of control systems. Fundamentals of mathematical modeling of dynamic systems. Transfer function and impulse response. Transient and steady-state response analysis. Stability analysis: Routh-Hurwitz stability criterion. Bode diagram. Magnitude versus phase-angle diagram. Proportional, integral and derivative (PID) controller. Design and analysis of control systems using root locus and frequency response methods. Applications to Biomedical Engineering: control of biomedical instruments, ventilators, infusion pumps and electronic cribs; control of prostheses with feedback from tactile sensors; control of ventilators by thoracic pressure; biofeedback equipment; biological systems with electrostimulation.

TÓPICOS AVANÇADOS EM ANÁLISE DE SINAIS E.ementa: Time-frequency analysis: Continuous and Discrete Wavelet Transform, concept, implementation and 1D and 2D applications. Hilbert transform, instantaneous phase and Empirical Mode Decomposition. Information theory applied to biomedical signals and images. Nonlinear methods in Biomedical Signals: introduction to deterministic dynamical systems, embedding and state-space methods, recurrence quantification analysis, dimension estimation, causality measures between signals and connectivity analysis, complexity measures. Advanced methods in image segmentation: edge-based and region-based segmentation; segmentation using active contours, GVF; Fuzzy Connectedness; K-Means, Fuzzy C-Means.

TÓPICOS AVANÇADOS EM BIOENGENHARIA.ementa: Introduction to Bioengineering. Laboratory methods that revolutionized cellular and biomolecular research (ELISA, PCR, Western Blot, immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, flow cytometry). Relevance of experimental models in research. Biomolecular Engineering: laboratory cell culture and its applications; cell signaling maps; concepts and definitions of stem cells and applications in tissue engineering; basic concepts of pharmacology and mechanism of drug action; notions of nanobiotechnology and drug delivery. Immunological Engineering: basic concepts of immunology; antibodies as research tools; immunotherapy; concepts of vaccine production; and biocompatibility.

TÓPICOS AVANÇADOS EM CIRCUITOS E ELETRÔN.ementa: Review of topics: analysis techniques (mesh current method, node voltage method, superposition, source transformation), Thévenin and Norton theorems; analysis of first- and second-order circuits in the time domain (RC, RL, RLC), sinusoidal steady-state analysis, impedance, phasor analysis; magnetically coupled circuits (mutual inductance, transformers), semiconductors (diodes and transistors). The following topics will be directed at themes relevant to Biomedical Engineering (i.e. instrumentation and analysis of physiological signals): applications of instrumentation amplifiers, Laplace transform, passive and active filters (frequency domain - high-pass, low-pass, band-pass, band-stop), noise analysis (emphasis on filters used in biomedical devices, i.e. electroencephalogram, electrocardiogram, electromyography..), electrophysiology and biomedical instrumentation, introduction to modeling and the H-H (Hodgkin-Huxley) model.

TÓPICOS AVANÇADOS EM ENGENHARIA BIOMÉDIC.ementa: Definition and importance of biomedical engineering and its subareas; national and international presence of the main representative bodies in the field; job market and research/development from the institutions' point of view; general concepts, typical applications and updates on biomedical instrumentation, medical engineering, bioengineering, clinical/hospital engineering, medical imaging and rehabilitation engineering. Presentation, discussion and implementation of projects and technological advances related to the role of biomedical engineering in the medical and biological fields.

TÓPICOS AVANÇADOS EM ÓTICA BIOMÉDICA.ementa: Optical properties of biological tissues - reflection; scattering; transmission; absorption. Properties of light: lasers, LEDs and diodes. Electromagnetic spectrum; applications of ultraviolet, visible and infrared (near, mid and far IR) radiation in the life sciences. Introduction to phototherapy: laser-biological tissue interaction. Main medical lasers; technical standards for protection when using lasers. High-intensity lasers: operating principles; interactions with biological tissues; dosimetry; applications in medicine and dentistry. Low-intensity lasers: operating principles; interactions with biological tissues; dosimetry; applications in medicine, dentistry and physiotherapy. Photodynamic therapy: principles and main medical applications. Photobiostimulation: principles and main medical applications. Thermotherapies: principles and main medical applications. Basic concepts and applications of absorption spectroscopy, fluorescence, vibrational spectroscopy (FTIR and Raman) and their applications in diagnosis

NEUROCIÊNCIA E COMPORTAMENTO.ementa: This theoretical-practical course explores the application of neuroscience to improve essential skills for both personal development and professional success. Based on neuroscience principles, the course offers practical strategies to optimize learning, including techniques to improve studying, memory and attention, as well as to promote well-being and the development of emotional intelligence. In the professional sphere, the course focuses on developing competencies highly valued by the job market, such as teamwork, effective communication, emotional intelligence and conflict resolution. Participants will learn and practice emotional management and regulation strategies, with the goal of developing and following individual projects for improving socio-emotional skills (soft skills), integrating the acquired knowledge for application in social and professional contexts. Topics: Concepts and Fundamentals of Neuroscience; Neuroplasticity; Types of Mindset and Their Implications; Learning and Memory; Neuroscience and Well-Being; Emotions and Emotional Regulation; Neuroscience and Technologies; Socio-Emotional Competencies Required Today; Fundamentals of Neuroscience for the Development of Soft Skills; Soft Skills: Personal/Individual Characteristics and Interpersonal Skills; Neuroscience of Decision-Making/Cognitive Skills; Competencies of a Leader; Neuroscience of Change.

TRANSDUÇÃO DE GRANDEZAS BIOMÉDICAS.ementa: Introduction: basic concepts of measurement methods. Basic structure of sensors: analog electrical devices and measurements. Noise and coherent interference in signal transduction. Measurements with DC and AC devices. Biomedical quantities. Mechanisms and sensors for the acquisition of biomedical signals: measurements of electric potential, temperature, flow, pressure and tension. Sensors and their applications in biomedicine. Biomagnetic sensors and their applications. Digital interface and measurement systems. Introduction to digital signal conditioning. Examples of measurement system design.
